components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one call-to-action color — create/save/apply actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Montserrat, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; background: #78c2ad; color: #fff; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #78c2ad; border-radius: 0.4rem; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #66a593; border-color: #609b8a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(140, 203, 185, 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #609b8a; border-color: #5a9282; }

components.name: Row Action Buttons
components.description: Icon-only row actions colored by verb: warning=edit, success=duplicate, danger=delete (The Action-Color Rule).
components.css: .ds-row-actions { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-row-actions button { color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.4rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-warning { background: #ffce67; } .ds-btn-warning:hover { background: #ffc341; } .ds-btn-success { background: #56cc9d; } .ds-btn-success:hover { background: #3dc28e; } .ds-btn-danger { background: #ff7851; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #ff5c2e; } .ds-row-actions button:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(0,0,0,0.15); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field — plain Bootstrap form-control.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-field label { font-family: Montserrat, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; color: #5a5a5a; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-field input { border: 1px solid #ced4da; border-radius: 0.4rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; color: #888; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #a8d5c8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(120, 194, 173, 0.25); }

components.name: Navbar
components.description: Fixed-top mint navbar with a house-glyph brand mark and outline-light utility buttons.
components.css: .ds-navbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; background: #78c2ad; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: Montserrat, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-navbar-brand { font-size: 1.5rem; color: #fff; margin-right: auto; } .ds-navbar-btn { background: transparent; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #fff; border-radius: 0.4rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-navbar-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }

components.name: Hoverable Table
components.description: Flat, hairline-bordered data table with row hover, no zebra striping, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color: #888; } .ds-table th { font-family: Montserrat, -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; color: #5a5a5a; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; } .ds-table td { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04); }

narrative.overview: Gestione Casa is a private tool for one household, not a product being sold to anyone — so it spends zero effort disguising that it runs an unmodified Bootswatch theme ("Minty") on top of Bootstrap 5.3. There is no logo beyond a house glyph, no custom type ramp, no bespoke component library. The one deliberate choice was which stock theme to reach for: Minty's mint-teal-and-coral-blush palette and generously rounded corners already read as soft and approachable without anyone drawing a single custom shape. The system's honesty is the point — it looks exactly as designed as it is, which is: not much, on purpose. Surfaces are flat, spacing follows Bootstrap's default scale untouched, and the only custom CSS in the whole app is a handful of overrides for things Bootstrap doesn't ship natively. Light/dark mode is Bootstrap 5.3's built-in data-bs-theme color-mode switch, not a hand-tuned dark palette.
keyCharacteristics: Stock Bootstrap 5.3 + Bootswatch "Minty" theme, unmodified beyond a few structural CSS overrides.
Mint teal primary, coral blush secondary — soft and approachable by virtue of the theme choice, not custom design work.
Flat throughout: no shadows, no elevation system, no glassmorphism.
Montserrat for headings/buttons/nav/legends; the system's default sans-serif stack for body text and form values.
Light/dark handled entirely by Bootstrap's native color-mode attribute.

rules.name: The Action-Color Rule
rules.body: Row-level actions are colored by verb, not by position or emphasis: primary (mint) creates, warning (yellow) edits, success (green) duplicates, danger (coral-red) deletes.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Exactly two type roles exist: Montserrat for structure (headings, nav, buttons, legends) and system-sans for content (everything a user reads as data or types as input).

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Don't add box-shadow for decoration or hierarchy. If two surfaces need to read as separate, use a border or a background-color/spacing gap.

dos: Do reuse Minty's semantic colors (primary/secondary/success/warning/danger/info) for any new UI — never introduce a new brand hex.
Do color row/inline actions by what they do, per the Action-Color Rule.
Do keep body and table text on the system sans-serif stack; reserve Montserrat for headings, buttons, nav, and legends.
Do label every icon-only button with title + aria-label.
Do confirm every mutation with a sonner toast in the matching semantic color.
donts: Don't add box-shadow, glassmorphism, or gradients anywhere.
Don't wrap new content in Bootstrap .card — this app has never used cards.
Don't hand-tune the dark theme — light/dark is Bootstrap's native data-bs-theme switch.
Don't let the PWA manifest's theme_color/background_color drift further from the actual Bootstrap primary.
